1.consolidated_definition: dep. Deporte náutico que consiste en desplazarse sobre una tabla de 2 a 4.7 m. provista de una vela. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. También windsurf. Deportes como vela, surfing, wind surfing y voleibol de playa… hay un sinnúmero de actividades que podemos hacer
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Paddleboard (n.) 
Sport of nautical recreation that consists in moving on a board of 2 to 4.7 m provided with a sail. A crude anglicism, not very frequent. Also known as windsurfing. Like sailing, surfing, wind surfing and beach volleyball... there are numerous activities we can do
